prerequisites: Student possesses basic knowledge of fluid mechanics.
Student can solve differential equations of mathematical models of hydraulic components and systems.
Student possesses basic knowledge of hydrostatic drive systems.

learning_outcomes.text: In the result of lesson student has knowledge for description of basic hydraulic systems in vehicles and heavy duty machines.
In the result of lesson student has knowledge for design of hydraulic drive systems.
In the result of lesson student has knowledge for description hydraulic components for control or regulation selected parameters.

In the result of lesson student is able to design hydraulic system with control system - make suitable calculations and on their basis student is able to select suitable hydraulic components with proper dimensions and properties.
In the result of lesson student is able to make measurements of hydraulic components and systems and describe results and formulate proper conclusions.
In the result of lesson student is able to build and start and analyse working hydraulic and electrohydraulic drive system.
Student can cooperate in group during hydraulic and electrohydraulic system building and report preparation.
Student can plan measurements and project preparation.
Student correctly identify and solve problems with hydraulic and electrohydraulic system during its building. Student formulate appropriate conclusions.

syllabus_topics: Introduction, lecture range presentation, check form, requirements, list of references.
Speed regulation of hydraulic motor during fast and working movement.
Cavitation effect, calculation of sucking line of hydraulic pump.
Introduction - laboratory topics presentation, check form, requirements. Laboratory regulations and industry safety.
Serial and parallel connection of hydraulic actuators.
Control of hydraulic system with proportional relief valve.
Hydraulic systems with check valves and flow regulator.
Methods of safety increasing in hydraulic systems - controlled check valve.
Functions and applications of relief valve with unloading.
Regulation with constant power in hydraulic system.
Comparison tests of speed control and regulation systems for hydraulic actuator.
Methods of power losses reduction in hydraulic systems.
Tests of dynamics processes in hydraulic systems.
Preparation of static characteristic of the system.
Description of system operation and selected components specification.
teaching_methods: traditional lecture with the use of transparencies and slides
self study - preparation for project class

assessment_methods.method: oral response for practical verification of design and building of systems

assessment_rules: For the lecture component, the final grade (P) is determined by the colloquium (F1). For the laboratory component, the final grade (P) is calculated as (2*F1+F2+F3)/4, where F1 is the oral response, F2 is the report, and F3 is student's activity note. For the project component, the final grade (P) is determined by the project check (F1).
